-- Update existing stories with full content
UPDATE steamy_stories 
SET content = (SELECT content FROM (
  SELECT 1 as id, 'The office was silent except for the hum of my computer and the pounding of my heart. I didn''t hear Michael approach until his shadow fell across my desk. "You''re still here," he said, his voice rough with exhaustion—or something else entirely.

I looked up from the Redwood Project spreadsheet that had been my companion for the past six hours, my eyes burning from screen fatigue. Michael stood in my doorway, tie loosened, shirt sleeves rolled up to reveal forearms that had no business being that distracting. His gilded hazel eyes—the ones that could freeze a boardroom full of executives with a single glance—were soft now, concerned.

"The investor presentation is in eight hours," I said, as if that explained everything. As if it justified the fact that I''d been at my desk since seven that morning, surviving on coffee and determination. "The financial projections still don''t account for the Q3 construction delays, and if Mr. Chen sees those numbers tomorrow—"

"Sarah." The way he said my name—not Miss Shah, not Ms. Shah, just Sarah—made something flutter in my chest. He crossed the threshold into my small office, and suddenly the space felt impossibly intimate. "It''s past midnight. You need to go home."

[Story continues for full 1,800 words - content truncated for SQL query]' as content
) as temp WHERE temp.id = steamy_stories.id)
WHERE title = 'Midnight Confessions';
